scope: Data-only normalized IL and decompiler AST member audit of the uploaded live-server assembly against the previous 979 c native assembly. No target game assembly execution was performed by this audit.
retainedGBehavior: Explicit pending-state schema and presence flags, g meaningful payload predicates and validation: implemented by the separate persistence owner.
Remote server owns SaveCurrent persistence and SaveWithFeedback does not report a stale local save timestamp.
Ending a Hero turn selects the next unfinished participating nondefeated Hero when the selection became ineligible.
Local hot-seat routing skips a stale completed Hero before Start Turn and selects another eligible Hero after an accepted End Turn.
candidateFixesToKeepRatherThanRevert: Remote snapshot application suppresses local gameplay effects and deck reconstruction.
Presentation creation waits for the authoritative snapshot, and remote startup skips local campaign resume/autosave.
Character presentation cancels old gameplay callbacks during remote state replacement.
Socket-bound ownership, reconnect proof, separate gameplay revisions, TLS and room access keys.

handoffImplementation.onlineScope: Router auto-selection disabled for remote TCP clients; existing actor/ownership semantics remain enforced.
handoffImplementation.regression: Existing 29-count router gate deliberately reselects completed Aldric, then requires Lyra selected/active, exactly 3 Actions and distinct persistent ownership session. Previous presentation-selection assertion remains.
handoffImplementation.validation: git diff --check passed. Unity compilation and runtime gate execution are delegated to the root builder; this audit does not claim them.

limitations: AST text equality and normalized fingerprints are evidence for compared code, not a formal behavior-equivalence proof.

Installed host assets, scenes, prefabs, content catalogs and configuration were not supplied or certified.
No production deployment, account access or save read/write occurred.
